title: What It Actually Looks Like to Kill a Sin You Still Kind of Like
caption:
You've been waiting to hate it before you fight it. Scripture never asked for disgust first.

Put to death doesn't mean feel dead toward it. Paul wrote that to men who still wanted the thing. And if you fall and get back up the same night, you're further along than the man who never fought at all.

Starve it at 3 p.m. Don't stare it down at 11.
